name: Bitfarms Ltd (now Keel Infrastructure Corp.)
note:
VERIFIED against SEC Form 10-Q, Keel Infrastructure Corp. (formerly Bitfarms Ltd.), quarter ended 2026-03-31 (filed 2026-05-11, acc. 0001213900-26-054166, CIK 0001812477). I could not fetch sec.gov directly (HTTP 403 from this environment), but every load-bearing figure is independently corroborated by (a) the StockTitan SEC-filing extract of the same 10-Q and (b) the issuer's own Q1 2026 results PR (investor.bitfarms.com, 2026-05-11), and (c) third-party press (The Block, Blockspace, crypto.news).

DEBT (all CONFIRMED, all RECOURSE): Total long-term debt net of costs/discount = $577.445M (current $4.242M / non-current $573.203M). Composed of: (1) $588M aggregate-principal 1.375% UNSECURED convertible senior notes due Jan 15 2031 — the dominant instrument (carrying ~$574.2M; $591.586M principal accrual less $17.358M unamortized discount; conversion price ~$6.86 / 145.6876 sh per $1,000); (2) building financing $1.687M; (3) equipment financing $1.530M. These are parent-level recourse obligations. Leases excluded from debt (finance ~$2.0M, operating ~$11.5M) — correct classification.

RECOURSE / JV CHECK (clean): No JV/consortium-headline conflation. Single consolidated SEC filer, NOT a Stargate-style multi-sponsor SPV. The only project-level instrument ever present was the Macquarie Panther Creek HPC/AI DDTL facility ($300M commitment, $100M drawn, 8%) — and it was secured at the project level BUT carried a PARENT GUARANTEE (so recourse reached the parent anyway), and it was FULLY REPAID Feb 2026 (~$116.9M paid; $21.6M loss on extinguishment), leaving $0 non-recourse/JV/SPV debt outstanding at 2026-03-31. The model did not misattribute any JV headline as recourse debt; $577.445M = 100% recourse is correct and conservative.

FINANCIALS (CONFIRMED): Revenue $36.992M (down ~22% YoY from $47.651M); net loss $145.353M; operating loss $98.388M; gross LOSS (cost of revenue $63.297M > revenue); company-defined EBITDA -$100.006M; Adjusted EBITDA -$16.71M (from +$6.903M YoY); cash & equivalents $357.277M; total stockholders' equity $419.135M; accumulated deficit $757.834M; discontinued-ops loss ~$17.8M (Argentina/Paraguay). verified_ebitda_usd reports the company-defined EBITDA (-$100.006M); note Adjusted EBITDA is -$16.71M.

in_financed_cluster=TRUE but QUALIFIED: The $577M recourse debt is real and material at an entity now strategically branded as AI/HPC digital infrastructure (Keel / Panther Creek campus). HOWEVER, the one DEDICATED AI/HPC project facility (Macquarie Panther Creek) was RETIRED in Feb 2026 and replaced with dilutive general-corporate converts; AI/HPC is still ~0% of revenue (pre-revenue), and the recourse converts fund the balance-sheet/pivot broadly rather than being earmarked HPC project debt. RED FLAGS confirmed and material: deep unprofitability, 22% revenue decline mid-pivot, $21.6M facility-unwind loss, equity erosion ($560M->$419M in one quarter), heavy reliance on one convert (conversion price $6.86 well above ~$5.28 reference), crypto MTM exposure ($168.5M BTC, $41.4M unfavorable change), and a contained historical SDIG (Stronghold) restatement/material-weakness flag absorbed via the March-2025 merger (no Keel-level restatement or going-concern). overall=source_backed: the load-bearing $577.445M debt figure is genuinely sourced (primary SEC 10-Q, independently corroborated).

LOAD-BEARING DEBT FIGURE IS SOURCED -> overall=source_backed. The recourse disentanglement in the extract is CORRECT and confirmed by the filing:
- $150.0M 4.0% convertible senior notes due 2030 (issued Oct 2025, incl. $15M greenshoe) are "senior and unsecured obligations" of Bit Digital PARENT. This is the genuine recourse debt -> verified_recourse_debt_usd = $150,000,000. Confirmed.

ADVERSARIAL CORRECTION ON TOTAL DEBT: The extract's total_debt_usd = $398M is NOT the reported balance-sheet figure and is a constructed/pro-forma estimate (gross converts + undrawn facilities). The ACTUAL 3/31/26 consolidated balance sheet shows the ONLY interest-bearing debt as 'Convertible notes payable, net' = $334,189,318. There is NO term-loan/bank-facility debt line in either current or non-current liabilities (RBC undrawn; Iceland drawn post-period). I therefore set verified_total_debt_usd = $334,189,318 (the reported net carrying of the $150M + $230M converts), which is the sourced figure. The ~$398M is unsupported as a balance figure and is nulled in favor of the actual $334.2M.

Q1 2026 net loss -$146,669,036 attributable (XBRL); -$150.3M total per MD&A. EBITDA: not disclosed (only appears in RBC covenant definitions; company states Adjusted EBITDA 'have not been calculated'); company is deeply loss-making, so null is correct. WhiteFiber ownership is ~70.1% per this 10-Q (71.5% at Aug 2025 IPO), not 70.7% as in the extract -- minor, consolidation conclusion unchanged. Nscale Services Agreement (Enovum/WhiteFiber, Nov 2025) confirmed in filing, supporting the GPU-cloud offtaker-concentration red flag.
